page.overview:
Who is Guardian's Town?

Guardian's Town is a location in Final Fantasy Legend II.

The party arrives in town, and it appears to be a simple normal town. Rumor has it that people appear and disappear suddenly in this town, and they say that they hear the Heroic Tune in the cafe every time. Talking to the bartender reveals that the party should use the jukebox.

The main character plays the Heroic Tune on the jukebox, which opens a secret door. Shortly after the door opens, the party is captured by two men accusing them of being spies.

The new gods launch an assault on Guardian's Base, and after the party makes their way out of the base. The entire town has been destroyed and overrun with monsters, and there is no one in sight. The item shop, weapon shop, and inn have all been relocated into the Pillar of Sky's Monster's World.
